title: instructor_roster
description: One person on the LAUNCH instructor roster. The record points at an individual (name and contact live there, never copied) and holds what LAUNCH needs to know about them as an instructor: their bio, what they can teach, where and when. A person is on the roster once; removing them is a soft delete and they can be added again later. Rules the schema cannot express: the individual exists and is not erased; no two live entries for one individual; individual_id never changes after creation; status defaults to active.
x_retention: Kept for history after a person is removed from the roster. When the individual is erased the entry is removed from the roster and everything that describes it is deleted, leaving an anonymous tombstone. (A written policy only; nothing enforces it yet.)

individual_id.description: The person on this roster: the id of an individual. Required. Must exist and not be erased. Never changes once set. One live roster entry per person.

status.description: active (on the roster and available to be assigned) or inactive (kept for history, not offered). Optional on create; the server sets active when absent.

bio.description: A short paragraph about the instructor, written for people choosing a class. Up to 2000 characters. Optional.

capabilities.description: Short tags for what the instructor can teach or do, such as 'prompting basics' or 'large rooms'. Up to 30 tags of up to 60 characters each. Optional.

service_area.description: Where the instructor will travel to teach, in plain words: 'Denver metro', 'online only'. Up to 300 characters. Optional.

availability.description: When the instructor can teach: one entry per day of the week, with start and end times. A day with no entry is not available. Up to 14 entries. Optional.

opens_at.description: Earliest time, 24-hour HH:MM, in the instructor's local time. Before closes_at.

closes_at.description: Latest time, 24-hour HH:MM, in the instructor's local time. After opens_at.

availability_notes.description: Anything about availability the weekly hours cannot say: 'not the first week of June'. Up to 1000 characters. Optional.

notes.description: Free text for the operator. Up to 2000 characters. Personal data. Optional.

id.description: UUID v4, set by the server; also the Firestore document id.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written under (currently 1). Set by the server.

created_at.description: When the record was created (UTC). Set by the server.

created_by.description: Who created it, as an actor string. Set by the server.

updated_at.description: When the record last changed (UTC). Set by the server.

updated_by.description: Who last changed it. Set by the server.

source.description: Where the record came from: dashboard or import. Set by the server.

deleted_at.description: When the record was soft deleted (UTC); absent while live. A deleted link is a mistake corrected, not a relationship that ended. Set by the server.

deleted_by.description: Who soft deleted it. Set by the server.
